speaker: ORAC
text: Narcea's quarantine beacons are active. Cross their scan and they'll fire.

speaker: JASON
text: Those coordinates cost a man his life. I'm not leaving empty-handed.

speaker: ORAC
text: I can blind the beacons. Unfortunately, that leaves nothing for the autopilot.

speaker: JASON
text: Then keep them blind. I'll fly.

speaker: ORAC
text: Follow the orange gate. Blue rings show the route ahead. Miss once and they notice us. Miss twice and they fire.

speaker: ORAC
text: You have control. Keep us in the corridor.
